scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/database && npm run migration:apply --workspace=@faultline/database
scripts.db:rollback: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/database && npm run migration:rollback --workspace=@faultline/database
scripts.db:migration:create: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/database && npm run migration:create --workspace=@faultline/database --
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test tests/infrastructure.test.cjs tests/clickhouse.test.cjs
scripts.telemetry:schema: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/clickhouse && npm run schema:apply --workspace=@faultline/clickhouse
scripts.telemetry:retention: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/clickhouse && node packages/clickhouse/dist/schema-cli.js retention
scripts.telemetry:clear: npm run build --workspace=@faultline/clickhouse && npm run schema:truncate --workspace=@faultline/clickhouse
